estonia.description: "Lihtsad uudised," meaning easy or simple news, is for anyone who wants to improve their Estonian language skills. Listen and read a selection of this week's news stories below.

estonia.title: Estonia's bear population continues to grow
estonia.description: The number of bears in Estonia continues to grow, a new report by the Environment Agency shows, while the number of foxes and roe deer has fallen.

estonia.title: French investor puts €1 million into Lääne-Viru County wood plant
estonia.description: The France‑based company Puidukoda has invested €1 million in its production facility in Näpi, Lääne‑Viru County. But Estonia's geopolitical location is making such investments increasingly difficult to attract.

estonia.title: Police not opening corruption investigation at Estonian National Opera
estonia.description: The Police and Border Guard Board (PPA) will not open an investigation into the Estonia National Opera's cast planner over reported corruption allegations, as no criminal offence was identified in her conduct.

estonia.title: Outgoing envoy to US: Americans view Estonia positively
estonia.description: Kristjan Prikk, Estonia's outgoing ambassador to the United States, considers Estonia's recognition and image in the U.S. remarkable given Estonia's population, economic size and distance from America. Even if many Americans do not know specific details about Estonia, they tend to associate it with something positive.

estonia.title: Gallery: Exhibition '5MIINUST 10 Years' opens at Estonian National Museum
estonia.description: Estonian band and Eurovision entrants 5MIINUST is celebrating its 10th anniversary this week, and an exhibition marking the band's 10 years of activity has opened at the Estonian National Museum (ERM) in Tartu.

estonia.title: Swedbank's half-year profits total €122 million
estonia.description: Swedbank's net profit in Estonia for the first six months of this year was €122 million, €6.2 million less than in the same period last year.

estonia.title: Summer opera performances come to Tallinn's Town Hall for 3 weeks
estonia.description: The Citizens' Hall (Tallinna Raekoda) on Tallinn's Town Hall Square will transform into an opera house in July and August for the seventh year in a row.

estonia.title: UK to deploy more soldiers and preposition ammunition in Estonia
estonia.description: Around 300 additional British soldiers will be deployed to Estonia next year under a new bilateral cooperation plan signed by the two countries on Thursday.

estonia.title: Ida-Viru County water sports center aspires to host international competitions
estonia.description: A water sports center in Ida-Viru County wants to host international competitions in the future and is looking for interested people to help set up a new sports club and create a community.

estonia.title: Rally Estonia returns with 53 crews set for WRC action in South Estonia
estonia.description: Rally Estonia returns from Thursday, marking round nine of the World Rally Championship (WRC) 2026 season and bringing a total of 53 crews from 23 countries to South Estonia.

estonia.title: Scottish punk legends The Exploited giving outdoor gig in Tallinn
estonia.description: Legendary Scottish second-wave punk band The Exploited will be giving an outdoor gig in Tallinn this Saturday, a date replacing a canceled gig from earlier in the year.

estonia.title: Saaremaa Opera Days open in the courtyard of Kuressaare Castle
estonia.description: The 19th Saaremaa Opera Days begin in the Kuressaare Castle courtyard, running from July 18 to 25. This year's headliner is Italy's Livorno Goldoni Opera House, while Estonia's top soloists will appear in the first part of Richard Wagner's opera tetralogy "The Ring of the Nibelung", "Das Rheingold", staged jointly by Eesti Kontsert and the National Theatre Vanemuine.

estonia.title: Prime minister: Estonia can fund defense and still cut spending
estonia.description: Estonia must continue cuts as real talks over budget begin in late summer, despite competing spending demands, Prime Minister Kristen Michal (Reform Party) said in an interview.

estonia.title: US 'close' to resuming weapons deliveries, says Estonian officials
estonia.description: Estonia's ambassador in Washington has said the US is "close" to resuming weapons deliveries, which were suspended after the start of the war in Iran this spring. Minister of Defense Hanno Pevkur (Reform) said they would arrive in the "coming months."

estonia.title: Estonia's cinema attendance up 9,000 in first half of 2026
estonia.description: The first half of this year brought 1,259,717 visitors to Estonian cinemas, about a 0.7‑percent increase from the same period in 2025.

estonia.title: Highest UV index reading in Estonia recorded in Haapsalu
estonia.description: The highest ultraviolet (UV) index ever measured in Estonia was recorded in Haapsalu last month, while a reading nearly as high was taken in Pärnu at the same time.

estonia.title: Tallinn Airport sets new record, but fewer Estonians are traveling this year
estonia.description: Tallinn Airport served 373,000 passengers in June, setting a new all-time record. At the same time, travel agencies say they are seeing fewer customers and attribute the decline to the economic situation.

estonia.title: Kristina Schotter: The limits of the prescription drug advertising ban need clarity
estonia.description: A recent weight‑loss campaign drew public attention to the question of where a permitted health campaign ends and prohibited prescription drug advertising begins. The rules should be clearly worded, not vague, writes Kristina Schotter.

estonia.title: A first for Estonia: Fully electric aircraft lands at Tartu Airport
estonia.description: Aviation history was made at Tartu Airport on Wednesday when the Elektra Trainer, a fully certified electric airplane, landed after a flight from Helsinki.

estonia.title: Rally Estonia brings flight restrictions to south of the country
estonia.description: Rally Estonia starts today, Thursday and the airspace above restricted areas relating to the race are closed to unauthorized air traffic, both piloted and remotely controlled.

estonia.title: Elering tests reliability of Estonia's power system
estonia.description: Estonian grid operator Elering carried out a technical test of the power system on Wednesday, known as a black‑start test, to check readiness for situations where part of the grid must temporarily operate separately from the rest of the system.

estonia.title: Young birds on the move increase summer hazards for Estonia's drivers
estonia.description: Drivers are being urged to stay vigilant as fledgling birds, including flightless waterfowl, are appearing alongside—and sometimes on—Estonia's roads.

estonia.title: Food delivery apps must offer reusable packaging option from 2028
estonia.description: Food delivery apps will have to offer customers the option of reusable packaging from 2028 under new rules accompanying EU packaging legislation.

estonia.title: Plan for paid alcohol permits could reduce Estonia's outlet count
estonia.description: The Ministry of Social Affairs is weighing whether to introduce fees for alcohol sales permits, which are currently issued free of charge, in an effort to limit the record number of sales outlets.

estonia.title: Court fight over Eurovision song could complicate music teaching and live shows
estonia.description: A court dispute between composer Ivar Must and the Estonian Film Institute over a modified performance of the Eurovision song "Everybody" raises concerns that any changes to musical works may require direct author approval.

estonia.title: Estonia mulls extending statute of limitations for crimes against children
estonia.description: The Ministry of Justice has developed a plan to extend the period of time a victim of child abuse can report a crime against them from the current 10-years to 32 years or until the victim turns 50 years old.

estonia.title: Watch | Gaea Schoeters: Colonialism is still part of our culture
estonia.description: Belgian author and screenwriter Gaea Schoeters took part a conversation at the HeadRead literary festival earlier this year, discussing language, translation and the power of fiction.

estonia.title: Hans Väre: But perhaps rules do have a reason after all
estonia.description: Most people would agree that a green‑fingered neighbour selling surplus potatoes and pumpkins from the backyard, or a schoolkid offering homemade lemonade, should not get caught in the gears of bureaucracy. But there must always be a limit somewhere, writes Hans Väre.

estonia.title: Tallinna FC Flora out of UEFA Champions League
estonia.description: Estonian Meistriliiga team Tallinn FC Flora's 2-2 away draw against Georgian side FC Iberia 1999 in the second leg of their Champions League qualifier round one tie was not enough to keep them in the running.

estonia.title: Sweden's Hanza buys metalworking factory in Narva from Finland's Fortaco
estonia.description: Swedish manufacturer Hanza will buy a metalworking plant in Estonia's Narva, employing 400 people, and will become one of the biggest employers in the eastern border city.

estonia.title: Transport authority: Majority of drivers in Estonia ignore traffic lights
estonia.description: Over half of drivers in Estonia ignore red and amber traffic lights, according to a recent study.

estonia.title: High‑earning fathers most likely to use Estonia's parental benefit while continuing to work
estonia.description: Estonia's flexible parental‑leave rules often allow high‑earning fathers to collect benefits while continuing to work, a pattern researchers say can undermine the policy's original goal of letting one parent step back from employment to care for a newborn.

estonia.title: Research center: Milk, butter prices in Estonia continue to fall
estonia.description: The price of both milk and butter fell in the second quarter of 2026 (Q2 2026), data from the Center of Estonian Rural Research and Knowledge (METK) shows.

estonia.title: Jürgenson ja Enok maadlevad Rally Estonia keeruliste oludega
estonia.description: Romet Jürgensoni ja Patrick Enoki jaoks kujunes Rally Estonia teise võistluspäeva hommik eelkõige võitluseks keeruliste teeolude ja sügavate rööbastega. Mõlemad Eesti sõitjad tõid välja sama probleemi just rööbastes lõikudes kadus konkurentidega võrreldes kõige rohkem aega.

estonia.title: Uue hingamise leidnud Solberg hakkas pinget kruvima ja survestab Pajarit
estonia.description: Autoralli maailmameistrivõistluste 9. etapil Eestis on sõidetud üle 170 km kiiruskatseid ehk üle poole võistlusest on läbitud. Karjääri esimest MM-ralli võitu jahib soomlane Sami Pajari (Toyota), tiimikaaslane Oliver Solberg jääb 14,1 sekundi kaugusele ning tundub minevat aina paremasse hoogu.

estonia.title: Tsahkna sõnul annaks USA senaatori läbimurdeline sanktsioonipakett tugeva löögi Vene majandusele
estonia.description: Sel nädalal kinnitati, et Ameerika Ühendriikide senatis on senaatorite Lindsey Grahami ja Richard Blumenthali algatatud Venemaa-vastase sanktsioonipaketi eelnõu kogunud enam kui 60 senaatori ning Valge Maja toetuse. Paketi eesmärk on kehtestada tollimaksud riikidele, kes jätkavad Venemaa nafta ja gaasi ostmist või aitavad Moskval kehtestatud sanktsioonidest kõrvale hiilida.

estonia.title: Madridi peretoetuste seadus võib sillutada teed abordi kriminaliseerimisele
estonia.description: Madridi konservatiivne piirkonnavalitsus võttis vastu seaduse, mille eesmärk on julgustada peresid rohkem lapsi sünnitama. Kriitikute hinnangul võib näiliselt perepoliitiline meede avada ukse abordiõiguse piiramisele, kirjutab Politico.

estonia.title: Kodune lõheroog, kus kohtuvad mesi, sinep ja sidrun
estonia.description: Mõnusalt mahlane lõhe, millele annavad iseloomu mesi, sinep ja sidrun. Koos krõbedate ahjukartulite ja värske salatiga valmib tasakaalus õhtusöök, mida on lihtne teha ja mõnus serveerida.

estonia.title: Suri viimane elu päästnud raudkopsu kasutanud inimene
estonia.description: Ameeriklane Martha Lillard haigestus 1953. aastal lastehalvatusse ja kasutas sellest ajast peale hingamiseks nn raudkopsu. Ta suri 26. juunil 2026 ja oli viimane inimene, kes sellist hingamise abivahendit kasutas. Õhku jääb küsimus, kas lastehalvatuse ajastu võib sellega lõppenuks lugeda.

estonia.title: Esikohta hoidev Virves pole kõigega rahul: üllatusi on rohkem, kui tahaks
estonia.description: Robert Virves jätkab Rally Estonia teisel võistluspäeval tugevat sõitu ning hoidis hommikuse ringi järel WRC2-arvestuse liidrikohta. Hoolimata heast positsioonist tunnistas eestlane, et rooli taga pole enesetunne veel päris selline, nagu ta sooviks.

estonia.title: Venemaa kehtestas Eesti veokite kaubavedudele uued piirangud
estonia.description: Venemaa valitsus laiendas uue määrusega Eesti registris olevate veokite kaubaveo piiranguid, kehtestades kõikidele kaubakategooriatele täieliku keelu, kirjutab Kommersant.

estonia.title: KADRI PAAS ⟩ Valutu nakkus, mis muudab maailmapilti
estonia.description: Kas tehisintellekt edendab Vene propagandat? Hiljutiste uuringute järgi peavad niisugused kahtlused paika, sest Venemaal on õnnestunud suuri keelemudeleid nakatada oma valedega.

estonia.title: UURING ⟩ Roheline Vahemere-dieet võib mõjutada isegi sinu geene
estonia.description: Vahemere-dieet on tuntud kui üks tervislikumaid toitumisviise. See sisaldab rohkelt köögi- ja puuvilju, täisteratooteid, kaunvilju, pähkleid ja oliiviõli ning vähe punast liha, suhkrut ja töödeldud toitu.

estonia.title: Rasv käsivartel või alaseljal? Su keha üritab sulle midagi olulist öelda
estonia.description: Kuigi oleme harjunud pidama rasva millekski, millest tuleks iga hinna eest vabaneda, on rasvkude tegelikult kehale ülioluline. See pole pelgalt passiivne tagavara, vaid aktiivne süsteem, mis toodab ainevahetust ja söögiisu reguleerivaid hormoone ning mõjutab otseselt meie insuliinitundlikkust. Kuid siin peitub ka lõks – kui kaloritega liialdada, hakkavad rasvarakud kontrollimatult vohama. See aga tekitab kehas kroonilise põletiku ja rikub ainevahetust.

estonia.title: Rallialal kriminaalses joobes paarutanud mees lõpetas arestimajas
estonia.description: Rally Estonia on täies hoos ning see on üldjoontes läinud politsei silmis hästi, kuid eile leidis aset ka üks ohtlik olukord, kui rallialal paarutas keset päeva kiiruskatsete vahel autoga ringi kriminaalses joobes mees.

estonia.title: Venemaad nörritab Jõgeveste punamonumendi eemaldamine
estonia.description: Venemaa välisministeerium esitas Eesti asjurile Moskvas Marek Ühtegile protesti seoses Valgamaal Jõgevestes asunud nõukogude sõdurite monumendi eemaldamisega, vahendab ERR.

estonia.title: James Franco salapärased TikToki tulnukavideod koguvad miljoneid vaatamisi
estonia.description: James Franco on viimasel ajal sotsiaalmeedias silma paistnud veidrate postituste laviiniga. Sel korral avaldas ta video, mis väidab end paljastavat tulnukate tegevust.

estonia.title: «Appi, kas keegi on uppunud?» NOA restorani lähistel tiirutanud päästekopter tekitas inimestes ärevust
estonia.description: Tallinna ja Viimsi piiril NOA restorani lähistel mere ääres avanes laupäeval vaatepilt, mis pani nii mõnegi inimese muretsema. Mere kohal tiirutas juba mitu tundi päästekopter ning pealtnägija sõnul laskusid kopterilt vette ka tuukrid. PPA pressiesindaja sõnul aga muret tundma ei pea.

estonia.title: OTSEBLOGI JA GALERII ⟩ Rally Estonia: Solberg osutab Pajarile vastupanu, Virves lõpetas päeva esimese poole liidrina
estonia.description: Reedel alanud Rally Estonia avapäeval võidutses kõigil katsel, millega kasvatas sisse üsna kindla edu. WRC2-arvestuses jätkab liidrina Robert Virves. Kokku on Rally2-autodega stardis kaheksa eestlast. Postimees teeb rallist põhjaliku otseblogi.

estonia.title: LUGEMISSOOVITUS ⟩ Ammune ulmeklassika, mis paneb kujutlusvõime tööle
estonia.description: Rahvusraamatukogu kultuurinõunik Karl Martin Sinijärv soovitab lugeda Larry Niveni jutukogu «Neutrontäht». Niven on üks 20. sajandi teise poole tähtsaim tõsiteadusliku fantastika (ingl hard science fiction) viljeleja.

estonia.title: Ära lahku hotellitoast enne, kui oled seda pildistanud – lihtne nipp, mis võib säästa sadu eurosid
estonia.description: Enamik reisijaid pildistab puhkusel vaateid, toitu ja vaatamisväärsusi, kuid reisieksperdid soovitavad enne hotellist lahkumist teha veel ühe foto – oma hotellitoast. Selleks kulub vaid mõni sekund, kuid see võib hiljem aidata vältida vaidlusi, leida kadunud asju või isegi tõendada, et tuba jäi sinust maha heas korras.

A NATO-csúcs megmutatta az új nemzetközi rendet, Magyar Péter számára mérföldkő volt a találkozó
latvia.description: Az idei NATO-csúcsból Európa erősebben, a szövetség gyengébben került ki, a legnagyobb eredmény pedig az, hogy nem történt semmi. A török fővárosban kihalt utcák, a diplomáciai nagyüzem tömött csarnokai és a fórumon debütáló magyar delegáció tagjai fogadták a HVG stábját. Egy héttel később az Egyensúly Intézet konferenciáján szakértők és politikusok elemezték a csúcs jelentőségét.

latvia.title: A gyógyszer már létezik, de a magyar beteg mégsem kapja meg, ezért nagyobb eséllyel hal meg
latvia.description: Riasztó lemaradásra figyelmeztetnek

latvia.title: "Stary, dobry Senat" powoli znika. Kto przejmie pałeczkę po politycznych weteranach?
latvia.description: Śmierć senatora Lindseya Grahama to symbol końca pewnej ery. Stara szkoła cichej kuluarowej polityki ustępuje miejsca politycznemu spektaklowi. Dziś bardziej niż dobro partii liczy się budowanie osobistej marki. Kongres stoi w obliczu zmiany pokoleniowej, która zaważy na kształcie amerykańskiej polityki.

latvia.title: Seria uderzeń. Ukraina zaatakowała obiekty w Rosji
latvia.description: Prezydent Wołodymyr Zełenski poinformował, że Ukraina zaatakowała między innymi dwa obiekty logistyczne oraz naftowy w Rosji. Opublikował nagrania, na których widać ogromne słupy dymu po uderzeniach.

latvia.title: Ukrajinskí velitelia dostali príkaz natočiť videá na podporu generála Syrského
latvia.description: Ukrajinskí velitelia mali podľa zdrojov dostať príkaz natočiť videá na podporu generála Syrského. V armáde pritom rastie otvorená kritika jeho vedenia.

latvia.title: Ukrajinští velitelé dostali rozkaz natočit videa na podporu Syrského
latvia.description: Velitelé ukrajinských brigád v sobotu ráno dostali rozkaz natočit videa na podporu nejvyššího velitele ozbrojených sil Oleksandra Syrského. V ukrajinských městech se totiž po odvolání dosavadního ministra obrany Mychajla Fedorova, se kterým měl Syrský spory, demonstruje za to, aby byl odvolán i on. Natočená videa mají velitelé zveřejnit do páté hodiny odpoledne (16:00 SELČ).

latvia.title: Ovocné keříky vybírejte i podle doby sklizně úrody
latvia.description: Léto nás většinou zásobuje ovocem natolik, že ho sotva stíháme sníst nebo zpracovat do zásob. Jaké rostliny, stromy a keře se proto vyplatí vysadit? Nejdříve bychom si měli ujasnit, co chceme sklízet, v jakém množství a v jakém období. Důležitá je také velikost prostoru, který máme k dispozici, a počet rostlin, které se do něj vejdou. Představujeme vám známé i méně obvyklé druhy drobného ovoce, na kterých si pochutná celá rodina.

latvia.title: Avertisment ONU: Unul din trei oameni nu își permite o dietă sănătoasă. Costul alimentelor a crescut cu 25% în ultimii cinci ani
latvia.description: Cel mai recent raport al Organizației Națiunilor Unite (ONU) privind securitatea alimentară și nutriția arată că aproape o treime din populația lumii nu își permite o alimentație sănătoasă. În același timp, costul unei diete echilibrate, care să asigure necesarul de nutrienți, a crescut cu 25% în ultimii cinci ani, potrivit News.ro.

latvia.title: Dieta „vikingului” Erling Haaland: 6.000 de calorii pe zi, din lapte crud, fripturi, ficat şi inimă de vită. Ce spun specialiștii
latvia.description: Norvegianul care a cucerit inimile fanilor la Cupa Mondială, Erling Haaland, în vârstă de 26 de ani, are un meniu uluitor, de 6.000 de calorii pe zi, de cel puţin două ori mai mult decât necesarul unui adult. Din alimentele pe care le consumă zilnic nu lipsesc mierea, ouăle proaspete, laptele crud, cafeaua îndulcită cu sirop de arţar, fripturile imense, pâinea cu maia, mierea, carnea roşie, peştele şi nici organe precum ficatul şi inima de vită.

latvia.title: Nicușor Dan spune că nici nu a văzut pistolul pe care l-a primit cadou de la Ergodan: „SPP mi-a spus: «o să-l păstrăm»”
latvia.description: Președintele Nicușor Dan a declarat într-un interviu pentru Observator News, întrebat dacă i-a plăcut pistolul pe care l-a primit cadou de la omologul său turc, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, la plecarea din Ankara, unde a avut loc Summitul NATO, că nici măcar nu a văzut arma.

latvia.title: China ameninţă cu contramăsuri după ce SUA au anunţat modificări privind vizele pentru jurnaliştii străini
latvia.description: China a condamnat vineri planurile guvernului american de a scurta drastic durata vizelor pentru mulţi vizitatori străini, inclusiv jurnalişti, Beijingul acuzând măsuri discriminatorii şi prevenind că ar putea lua „contramăsuri adecvate”, informează dpa.

latvia.title: Primarii și șefii CJ vor putea primi sporuri de până la 40% pentru proiectele europene. Ce alte schimbări aduce noua Lege a salarizării
latvia.description: Ministerul Muncii a publicat vineri după-amiază noul proiect al Legii salarizării personalului plătit din fonduri publice, care ar urma să intre în vigoare la 1 decembrie 2026. Documentul stabilește o valoare de referință de 4.100 de lei, coeficienți de salarizare cuprinși între 1 și 8 și un plafon general de 20% pentru sporurile acordate la nivelul fiecărui ordonator principal de credite. Față de varianta prezentată anterior, proiectul majorează până la 40% sporul pentru primarii și președinții de consilii județene implicați în proiecte europene și modifică mecanismul prin care vor fi protejate salariile care ar scădea după aplicarea noilor grile.

latvia.title: 10 milioane de dolari pentru uciderea lui Trump. O grupare din Irak anunță că banii au fost donați de militanți și susținători
latvia.description: Gruparea armată pro-iraniană „Rezistența Islamică din Irak” a anunțat o recompensă de 10 milioane de dolari pentru asasinarea președintelui SUA, Donald Trump, relatează Shafaq News.

latvia.title: Un blogger rus, susținător fervent al invaziei în Ucraina, a fost arestat după ce l-a numit pe Putin criminal de război
latvia.description: Bloggerul Ilya Remeslo, care l-a numit pe președintele Vladimir Putin „criminal de război”, a fost reținut la Sankt Petersburg în cadrul unui dosar penal privind „știrile false” despre armata rusă (art. 207.3, alin. 2 din Codul Penal al Federației Ruse), relatează TASS, citând o sursă din cadrul forțelor de ordine.

latvia.title: Retragerea SUA din Europa de Est amplifică îngrijorările Aliaţilor. Probabilitatea unui conflict NATO–Rusia până la finalul anului 2026
latvia.description: Câteva sute de militari americani desfăşuraţi în Estonia în timpul iernii trecute au fost retraşi discret, fără niciun semn clar privind momentul în care s-ar putea întoarce sau dacă se vor mai întoarce, le-a dezvăluit ministrul apărării Hanno Pevkur jurnaliştilor locali, când se pregătea să plece la summitul NATO de la Ankara din această lună, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: Miruță: „Două blocuri au fost construite ilegal la 100 de metri de un depozit de muniție”. 18 angajați ai MApN, cercetați de DNA
latvia.description: Două blocuri cu 128 de apartamente au fost construite la aproximativ 100 de metri de un depozit de muniție din Pitești, deși legea impunea o distanță minimă de 200 de metri, a declarat vineri ministrul interimar al Apărării, Radu Miruță. Acesta susține că avizul favorabil a fost emis ilegal, iar 18 angajați ai Ministerului Apărării, inclusiv un general de brigadă, sunt cercetați de procurorii DNA în acest caz.

latvia.title: Proiectul de lege al lui Lindsey Graham privind sancțiunile împotriva Rusiei are suficiente voturi pentru a fi adoptat de Senat
latvia.description: Un proiect de lege menit să întărească sancțiunile împotriva Rusiei, elaborat de regretatul senator republican Lindsey Graham, a obținut peste 60 de co-inițiatori, suficienți pentru a-i asigura adoptarea în Senatul SUA.

latvia.title: Inundații în Texas: doi morți. Statul american se pregătește pentru ploi istorice
latvia.description: Ploile torenţiale au provocat moartea a două persoane în Texas, după ce apele revărsate le-au luat prin surprindere în propriile vehicule, în timp ce statul se pregăteşte pentru precipitaţii „care vor bate toate recordurile” în următoarele 24 de ore, a declarat, joi, guvernatorul statului Texas, Greg Abbott, citat de Reuters.

latvia.title: Regatul Unit trimite încă 400 de militari în Estonia pentru consolidarea flancului estic al NATO
latvia.description: Regatul Unit va desfăşura încă 400 de militari în Estonia începând de anul viitor, în baza unui nou acord de apărare semnat cu ţara baltică, relatează joi dpa, potrivit Agerpres.

latvia.title: Sorin Grindeanu, revoltat de susținătorii lui Ilie Bolojan: „Efectiv este o sectă”
latvia.description: Sorin Grindeanu, preşedintele PSD, îi cataloghează pe susţinătorii lui Ilie Bolojan drept „o sectă” care, în pofida dificultăţilor financiare şi economice ale României, „aduce ode conducătorului iubit care a dus România în cap din punct de vedere economic”. El se arată „revoltat” de susţinerea pe care opozanţii PSD i-o acordă lui Ilie Bolojan, spunând că raţiunea de a fi împotriva PSD este singura care determină acţiunile acestora.

latvia.title: Dunărea, la cel mai mic debit din ultimii 30 de ani. Restricții în irigații pentru menținerea în funcțiune a centralei de la Cernavodă
latvia.description: Dunărea a atins, joi, cel mai mic debit istoric din ultimii 30 de ani, respectiv de 1750 mc/s, având o tendinţă de scădere pentru următoarele 4-5 zile, ajungând până la nivelul de 1700 mc/s, conform prognozei INHGA.

latvia.title: „Rușii testează”. Moscova a trimis a treia zi la rând avioane de vânătoare în largul coastei Mării Baltice. Aparatele, interceptate
latvia.description: Avioanele de vânătoare poloneze au interceptat încă două avioane de vânătoare rusești și un avion de recunoaștere în largul coastei Mării Baltice, a declarat joi ministrul polonez al apărării.

latvia.title: Oana Țoiu: România va găzdui în premieră un program de schimb cu SUA. Ministra de Externe a prezentat bilanțul vizitei în Statele Unite
latvia.description: Ministra Afacerilor Externe, Oana Țoiu, a prezentat, joi, bilanțul vizitei efectuate în Statele Unite, unde a avut întâlniri cu oficiali americani, reprezentanți ai mediului academic și ai unor think tank-uri. Șefa diplomației române a anunțat că, din această toamnă, România va găzdui în premieră Romania–United States Exchange Program, un program de schimb destinat consilierilor din Congresul SUA și experților americani.

latvia.title: EXCLUSIV | Istoricul Cosmin Popa: Nu este realist să așteptăm o cerere de armistițiu de la Rusia, dimpotrivă, se radicalizează / Toamna va fi a intensificării războiului și a extinderii fronturilor / Ce ar putea să oprească succesele militare ale Kievului
latvia.description: Ce se întâmplă cu Rusia? La finalul lunii iunie, președintele ucrainean Volodimir Zelenski promitea ”40 de zile de foc” pentru Rusia, în preajma Summitului NATO din Ankara, unde una dintre temele principale de discuție a fost războiul declanșat de dictatorul Vladimir Putin în 24 februarie 2022 și apărarea Ucrainei. La nici trei săptămâni de la […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Expert: Don't eat second-class mushrooms
latvia.description: In drier periods, when mushrooms are scarce, people are sometimes tempted to pick slightly old or damaged mushrooms, but this is not advisable, as such mushrooms can also cause digestive disorders, according to Diāna Meiere, a mycologist at the Latvian National Museum of Nature, on the Latvian Radio programme "How to Live Better".

latvia.title: Latvia's Baiba Braže returns from busy U.S. trip
latvia.description: Latvia's Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, has returned from a large-scale meeting in Washington, D.C., called by U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio the title of which was 'The Resurgence of Political Terrorism'.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 17th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Four city festivals for the weekend in Latvia
latvia.description: There's no excuse for being bored this weekend in Latvia. Not only is the weather set (reasonably) fair, but 'fairs' of other sorts abound. Here are a few to get you started.

latvia.title: Latvia has lots of (mainly female) judges
latvia.description: July 17th is the Day of International Criminal Justice, the anniversary of the adoption in 1998 of the Rome Statute, and the founding treaty of the International Criminal Court (ICC), which the United States recently announced it wants to 'dismantle'.

latvia.title: Rēzekne still trying to rent out its unwanted spa complex
latvia.description: Rēzekne City Council has approved changes to the auction rules for the lease rights of a spa complex [routinely rendered in Latvian as 'SPA' for reasons which remain opaque] at its July 17th meeting in a bid to get the enormous white elephant off its hands.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank publishes latest Macroeconomic Projections Report
latvia.description: The Latvian central bank, Latvijas banka (LB) published its latest Macroeconomic Projections Report online in English on July 16th.

latvia.title: Journalists expose online terrorism efforts in Poland and Baltics
latvia.description: Thousands of ads on the Telegram social media platform are looking for people to carry out sabotage and espionage tasks in Europe. This is the picture revealed by an investigation by the Polish-based media outlet Vot Tak. Among the recruiters' offers is to carry out malicious activities in Latvia.

latvia.title: Stores set fuel pellet purchase limits – producers say there's plenty to go around
latvia.description: As the result of a certain excitement in the fuel pellet market in recent weeks, stores have set limits on the purchase of pellets per person, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Warm weekend ahead in Latvia
latvia.description: There will be heat, rain, and thunderstorms in Latvia over the weekend, but the weather will become colder next week, according to forecasts.

latvia.title: Ghostly goings-on at Latvian Radio
latvia.description: In order to preserve the traditions of oral storytelling and collect the most vivid Latvian ghost stories, the Latvian Radio's legendary Radio Theatre invites everyone to send in their scary, mysterious or even funny horror stories until September 6. The best of the submitted stories will be narrated by an actor, and they will be available to listeners in the Autumn.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 16th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Women have longer working lives than men in Latvia
latvia.description: Based on 2025 data published by Eurostat on July 16th, people aged 15 and over in the EU are expected to work on average 37.5 years, up from 37.2 in 2024. Since 2016, the expected duration of working life in the EU has increased by 2.3 years, from 35.2 to 37.5. However, this indicator differs significantly between EU countries.

latvia.title: Small demonstration staged against closure of sports school
latvia.description: Around 20 people gathered outside the Ministry of Education and Science (IZM) building in Old Riga on Thursday morning to protest against the closure of the Jūrmala branch of the Murjāņi Sports Gymnasium (MSĢ).

latvia.title: Media speculates about airBaltic short-term financing
latvia.description: Latvian national airline airBaltic plans to seek short-term financing from bondholders, reports LSM's Latvian language service, which in turn cites the LETA newswire, which in turn cites Reuters, which cites a company statement.

latvia.title: New tourism brochure available for Valmiera district
latvia.description: As the tourist season hits its peak, Valmiera district in northern Latvia has prepared a new booklet outlining its active tourism offerings that may be of interest to foreign visitors as it is available in English.

latvia.title: Rīga to get a few more cycle lanes
latvia.description: To improve the availability of cycling infrastructure and promote safe cycling in the centre of the Latvian capital, Riga Municipality plans to create new sections of cycle lanes on Lāčplēša, Marijas, Šarlotes and Dzirnavu streets.

latvia.title: Almost a quarter of 'Latgale' election candidates live elsewhere
latvia.description: In the 15th Saeima elections, which are due to take place on October 3rd, there are fewer candidates standing in the eastern Latgale region than four years ago, and around one in four of those that are standing don't even live in the region.

latvia.title: Young Latvians lag behind neighbours in digital skills
latvia.description: In 2025, 74.6% of young people aged 16-24 in the EU had at least basic digital skills, according to data published by Eurostat on July 15th.

latvia.title: Liepāja advances in UEFA Conference League qualification
latvia.description: The football players of FK Liepāja won their second leg of the UEFA Conference League qualifying round first leg in Montenegro on Wednesday night and as a result secured a place in the second round of competition.

latvia.title: Auditors deliver damning report on Ogre district procurement practices
latvia.description: Ogre district municipality has not ensured transparent and responsible management of public funds, the State Audit Office (Valsts kontrole/VK) has concluded in an audit.

latvia.title: Researchers in Latvia concerned about potential threat to academic freedom
latvia.description: Researchers are expressing concerns about a possible threat to academic freedom after learning that the Saeima plans to discuss the usefulness of certain research.

latvia.title: Rinkēvičs: Latvia and Lithuanuia share 'a bond based on bloodline'
latvia.description: Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs continues his two-day visit to Lithuania on July 16th, as previously reported.

latvia.title: High hopes for ten turtles released into the wild in Latvia
latvia.description: Ten European turtles were released into the Ruģeļi wetland in Daugavpils on July 15th as part of an ambitious rewilding project, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 15th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia tweaks its military national service rules
latvia.description: On Tuesday, July 14th, the Cabinet of Ministers approved a draft law developed by the Ministry of Defence, which aims to improve the regulation of the State Defence Service (VAD) – Latvia's system of compulsory military conscription – based on the experience gained during the first six intakes.

latvia.title: Rīga bridge repairs likely to cause traffic disruption
latvia.description: During the extensive renovation of the Vanšu Bridge in central Rīga the carriageway could be completely closed to private vehicles with only public transport and emergency services able to use it.

latvia.title: Baltics and Poland warn again about potential Russian provocations
latvia.description: Lithuania has intelligence information indicating that Russia may be preparing to carry out provocations of some sort in the Baltic region, Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda said in an interview with the BNS news agency.

latvia.title: Carnikava may soon become a city
latvia.description: The village of Carnikava should be granted city status, the Saeima's State Administration and Local Government Committee decided on Wednesday, July 15th. The draft law has been given urgency, and it is planned that the law will come into force on August 22 to coincide with local festival celebrations.

latvia.title: LRT: Lithuania considering reintroducing checks on Latvian border
latvia.description: Lithuania's incoming Interior Minister Martynas Katelynas has not ruled out temporarily reintroducing border controls with Latvia as the number of migrants arriving from Belarus via Latvia continues to increase. Compared with the first half of last year, secondary migration from Latvia has risen fourfold, reports Lithuanian public media LRT.

latvia.title: Why did Daugavpils sell its buses? It's complicated
latvia.description: Daugavpils City Municipality-owned company SIA "Daugavpils autobusu parks" (Daugavpils bus park) has been sold for 1.48 million euros to SIA "RTS grupa". The deal has not yet been finalized, but the municipality has emphasized that no significant changes are expected for passengers - buses will continue to run according to the current schedule, as the transportation contract concluded with the state remains in force.

latvia.title: Latvia's Baiba Braže attending Rubio-called conference in Washington, D.C.
latvia.description: Latvian Foreign Minister Baiba Braže is in Washington, D.C. on July 15th and 16th "to attend a conference of foreign ministers hosted by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio," according to a brief release by the Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

latvia.title: Rēzekne to host second 'Dual-Use Export Forum'
latvia.description: Latvia's eastern city of Rēzekne will host the second “Latvian Dual-Use Export Forum” at the “GORS” concert hall on 7th September, it has been confirmed.

latvia.title: Berry good – Latvia's juiciest exports have growth potential
latvia.description: Latvia's berry exports are growing – in recent years, blackcurrant exports have reached a historically high level, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: President Rinkēvičs heads to Lithuania
latvia.description: Just a couple of weeks after heading north to visit Estonia, on July 15th President Edgars Rinkēvičs is heading south to visit Latvia's southern neighbour and fellow Baltic state, Lithuania.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 14th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Projections suggest significant population shrinkage for Latvia over next 25 years
latvia.description: Latvia's population is set to shrink substantially over the next few decades, according to Eurostat regional data published on July 14th.

latvia.title: Railway worker's remains found on Rīga island
latvia.description: The remains of a 'Latvijas dzelzceļš' (Latvian Railways) employee who fell into the Daugava River and went missing on Friday were found on Zaķusala island in Riga on Tuesday afternoon, police confirmed.

latvia.title: School's out: Latvian examination results similar to last year
latvia.description: The average results of centralized exams in primary education this year have not changed significantly compared to the previous school year, and 818 students have not passed a single exam. In secondary school, the results of centralized exams in Latvian and English have improved, but secondary school students have also shown worse results in mathematics, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: New VAT rules seem to be applied properly in Latvia
latvia.description: The Consumer Rights Protection Center (PTAC) has concluded that recently-introduced changes to value added tax (VAT, or PVN in Latvian) rates on four food product groups (eggs, milk, fresh poultry meat and bread), have in general been applied fairly by retailers.

latvia.title: Research institute merger forms new Latvian science centre
latvia.description: A National Institute of Research and Innovation (NIRI) has been established in Latvia by merging the Latvian Institute of Organic Synthesis and the Latvian Biomedical Research and Study Centre. Institute representatives believe that the merger will accelerate the development and implementation of new medicines, diagnostic methods and medical technologies, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Latvia joins call for EU to cut funding to International Olympic Committee
latvia.description: Latvia is one of at least eight European countries that will address the European Commission with a proposal to withdraw European Union (EU) funding for the International Olympic Committee (IOC) as a result of its attempts to rehabilite aggressor states Russia and Belarus in international competition.

latvia.title: Latvia's way with surnames can cause problems in other countries
latvia.description: In today's dynamic and global world, when borders between countries are becoming increasingly blurred and when Latvian citizens form families with citizens of other countries, travel and live all over the world, the rendering of surnames is an issue that can cause a number of problems.

latvia.title: Latvia's honorary consuls in Ukraine given awards
latvia.description: On Monday, July 13th, Minister of Defense Raivis Melnis met with Latvia's honorary consuls in Ukraine to present them with awards.

latvia.title: Textile waste a growing problem in Latvia
latvia.description: Textile waste is one of the biggest environmental burdens, accounting for approximately 3-5% of total waste. Moreover, its volume is increasing every year due to the increasing consumption of 'fast fashion', said Professor Inga Dāboliņa, head of the Personal Protective Equipment Laboratory at Riga Technical University, on the Latvian Radio program "Zināmais nezīnāmāja" ("The Known Unknown")

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 13th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Wolf and jackal hunting season starts this week in Latvia
latvia.description: Wolf hunting season in Latvia begins on July 15th, 2026.

latvia.title: Latvian Culture Minister suspends co-operation project with women's NGO network
latvia.description: Latvian Minister of Culture Nauris Puntulis (National Alliance) has issued an order suspendsing the right of the association "Latvian Women's Non-Governmental Organizations Cooperation Network" to carry out any further financial activities related to a project named "Social Diversity and Intercultural Communication for Professionals Working with Third-Country Nationals."

latvia.title: Russia planning to make sarcastic use of international courts against Baltics
latvia.description: Russia, a country that is a serial offender with scant regard for rule of law, nevertheless intends to use international courts to drag the Baltic states through various inconvenient and costly legal processes, according to a new report by the Re:Baltica investigative journalism portal.

latvia.title: Latvia's honorary consuls muster in Rīga
latvia.description: From 13th to 15th July 2026, the Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs will host the 12th Meeting of Latvian Honorary Consuls to provide updates on current issues in Latvian foreign policy, key security policy matters and opportunities for bilateral economic and cultural cooperation.

latvia.title: Viņu zina teju visi… Mirusi vēl viena leģendārās filmas “Viens pats mājās 2” zvaigzne
latvia.description: Īru aktrise Brenda Frikere, kura saņēma “Oskara” balvu par lomu 1989. gada filmā “Mana kreisā kāja” un atveidoja baložu dāmu kulta filmā “Viens pats mājās 2”, mirusi 81 gada vecumā, vēsta BBC. Aktrises aģents Fils Belfīlds sēru paziņojumā norādīja: “Mēs vairs nekad neredzēsim nevienu viņai līdzīgu, un bez viņas pasaule ir kļuvusi tukšāka.” Viņš piebilda: […]

lithuania.title: A NATO-csúcs megmutatta az új nemzetközi rendet, Magyar Péter számára mérföldkő volt a találkozó
lithuania.description: Az idei NATO-csúcsból Európa erősebben, a szövetség gyengébben került ki, a legnagyobb eredmény pedig az, hogy nem történt semmi. A török fővárosban kihalt utcák, a diplomáciai nagyüzem tömött csarnokai és a fórumon debütáló magyar delegáció tagjai fogadták a HVG stábját. Egy héttel később az Egyensúly Intézet konferenciáján szakértők és politikusok elemezték a csúcs jelentőségét.

lithuania.title: A gyógyszer már létezik, de a magyar beteg mégsem kapja meg, ezért nagyobb eséllyel hal meg
lithuania.description: Riasztó lemaradásra figyelmeztetnek

lithuania.title: "Stary, dobry Senat" powoli znika. Kto przejmie pałeczkę po politycznych weteranach?
lithuania.description: Śmierć senatora Lindseya Grahama to symbol końca pewnej ery. Stara szkoła cichej kuluarowej polityki ustępuje miejsca politycznemu spektaklowi. Dziś bardziej niż dobro partii liczy się budowanie osobistej marki. Kongres stoi w obliczu zmiany pokoleniowej, która zaważy na kształcie amerykańskiej polityki.

lithuania.title: Seria uderzeń. Ukraina zaatakowała obiekty w Rosji
lithuania.description: Prezydent Wołodymyr Zełenski poinformował, że Ukraina zaatakowała między innymi dwa obiekty logistyczne oraz naftowy w Rosji. Opublikował nagrania, na których widać ogromne słupy dymu po uderzeniach.

lithuania.title: Ukrajinskí velitelia dostali príkaz natočiť videá na podporu generála Syrského
lithuania.description: Ukrajinskí velitelia mali podľa zdrojov dostať príkaz natočiť videá na podporu generála Syrského. V armáde pritom rastie otvorená kritika jeho vedenia.

lithuania.title: Ukrajinští velitelé dostali rozkaz natočit videa na podporu Syrského
lithuania.description: Velitelé ukrajinských brigád v sobotu ráno dostali rozkaz natočit videa na podporu nejvyššího velitele ozbrojených sil Oleksandra Syrského. V ukrajinských městech se totiž po odvolání dosavadního ministra obrany Mychajla Fedorova, se kterým měl Syrský spory, demonstruje za to, aby byl odvolán i on. Natočená videa mají velitelé zveřejnit do páté hodiny odpoledne (16:00 SELČ).

lithuania.title: Ovocné keříky vybírejte i podle doby sklizně úrody
lithuania.description: Léto nás většinou zásobuje ovocem natolik, že ho sotva stíháme sníst nebo zpracovat do zásob. Jaké rostliny, stromy a keře se proto vyplatí vysadit? Nejdříve bychom si měli ujasnit, co chceme sklízet, v jakém množství a v jakém období. Důležitá je také velikost prostoru, který máme k dispozici, a počet rostlin, které se do něj vejdou. Představujeme vám známé i méně obvyklé druhy drobného ovoce, na kterých si pochutná celá rodina.

lithuania.title: Avertisment ONU: Unul din trei oameni nu își permite o dietă sănătoasă. Costul alimentelor a crescut cu 25% în ultimii cinci ani
lithuania.description: Cel mai recent raport al Organizației Națiunilor Unite (ONU) privind securitatea alimentară și nutriția arată că aproape o treime din populația lumii nu își permite o alimentație sănătoasă. În același timp, costul unei diete echilibrate, care să asigure necesarul de nutrienți, a crescut cu 25% în ultimii cinci ani, potrivit News.ro.

lithuania.title: Dieta „vikingului” Erling Haaland: 6.000 de calorii pe zi, din lapte crud, fripturi, ficat şi inimă de vită. Ce spun specialiștii
lithuania.description: Norvegianul care a cucerit inimile fanilor la Cupa Mondială, Erling Haaland, în vârstă de 26 de ani, are un meniu uluitor, de 6.000 de calorii pe zi, de cel puţin două ori mai mult decât necesarul unui adult. Din alimentele pe care le consumă zilnic nu lipsesc mierea, ouăle proaspete, laptele crud, cafeaua îndulcită cu sirop de arţar, fripturile imense, pâinea cu maia, mierea, carnea roşie, peştele şi nici organe precum ficatul şi inima de vită.

lithuania.title: Nicușor Dan spune că nici nu a văzut pistolul pe care l-a primit cadou de la Ergodan: „SPP mi-a spus: «o să-l păstrăm»”
lithuania.description: Președintele Nicușor Dan a declarat într-un interviu pentru Observator News, întrebat dacă i-a plăcut pistolul pe care l-a primit cadou de la omologul său turc, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, la plecarea din Ankara, unde a avut loc Summitul NATO, că nici măcar nu a văzut arma.

lithuania.title: China ameninţă cu contramăsuri după ce SUA au anunţat modificări privind vizele pentru jurnaliştii străini
lithuania.description: China a condamnat vineri planurile guvernului american de a scurta drastic durata vizelor pentru mulţi vizitatori străini, inclusiv jurnalişti, Beijingul acuzând măsuri discriminatorii şi prevenind că ar putea lua „contramăsuri adecvate”, informează dpa.

lithuania.title: Primarii și șefii CJ vor putea primi sporuri de până la 40% pentru proiectele europene. Ce alte schimbări aduce noua Lege a salarizării
lithuania.description: Ministerul Muncii a publicat vineri după-amiază noul proiect al Legii salarizării personalului plătit din fonduri publice, care ar urma să intre în vigoare la 1 decembrie 2026. Documentul stabilește o valoare de referință de 4.100 de lei, coeficienți de salarizare cuprinși între 1 și 8 și un plafon general de 20% pentru sporurile acordate la nivelul fiecărui ordonator principal de credite. Față de varianta prezentată anterior, proiectul majorează până la 40% sporul pentru primarii și președinții de consilii județene implicați în proiecte europene și modifică mecanismul prin care vor fi protejate salariile care ar scădea după aplicarea noilor grile.

lithuania.title: 10 milioane de dolari pentru uciderea lui Trump. O grupare din Irak anunță că banii au fost donați de militanți și susținători
lithuania.description: Gruparea armată pro-iraniană „Rezistența Islamică din Irak” a anunțat o recompensă de 10 milioane de dolari pentru asasinarea președintelui SUA, Donald Trump, relatează Shafaq News.

lithuania.title: Un blogger rus, susținător fervent al invaziei în Ucraina, a fost arestat după ce l-a numit pe Putin criminal de război
lithuania.description: Bloggerul Ilya Remeslo, care l-a numit pe președintele Vladimir Putin „criminal de război”, a fost reținut la Sankt Petersburg în cadrul unui dosar penal privind „știrile false” despre armata rusă (art. 207.3, alin. 2 din Codul Penal al Federației Ruse), relatează TASS, citând o sursă din cadrul forțelor de ordine.

lithuania.title: Retragerea SUA din Europa de Est amplifică îngrijorările Aliaţilor. Probabilitatea unui conflict NATO–Rusia până la finalul anului 2026
lithuania.description: Câteva sute de militari americani desfăşuraţi în Estonia în timpul iernii trecute au fost retraşi discret, fără niciun semn clar privind momentul în care s-ar putea întoarce sau dacă se vor mai întoarce, le-a dezvăluit ministrul apărării Hanno Pevkur jurnaliştilor locali, când se pregătea să plece la summitul NATO de la Ankara din această lună, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Proiectul de lege al lui Lindsey Graham privind sancțiunile împotriva Rusiei are suficiente voturi pentru a fi adoptat de Senat
lithuania.description: Un proiect de lege menit să întărească sancțiunile împotriva Rusiei, elaborat de regretatul senator republican Lindsey Graham, a obținut peste 60 de co-inițiatori, suficienți pentru a-i asigura adoptarea în Senatul SUA.

lithuania.title: Inundații în Texas: doi morți. Statul american se pregătește pentru ploi istorice
lithuania.description: Ploile torenţiale au provocat moartea a două persoane în Texas, după ce apele revărsate le-au luat prin surprindere în propriile vehicule, în timp ce statul se pregăteşte pentru precipitaţii „care vor bate toate recordurile” în următoarele 24 de ore, a declarat, joi, guvernatorul statului Texas, Greg Abbott, citat de Reuters.

lithuania.title: Regatul Unit trimite încă 400 de militari în Estonia pentru consolidarea flancului estic al NATO
lithuania.description: Regatul Unit va desfăşura încă 400 de militari în Estonia începând de anul viitor, în baza unui nou acord de apărare semnat cu ţara baltică, relatează joi dpa, potrivit Agerpres.

lithuania.title: Sorin Grindeanu, revoltat de susținătorii lui Ilie Bolojan: „Efectiv este o sectă”
lithuania.description: Sorin Grindeanu, preşedintele PSD, îi cataloghează pe susţinătorii lui Ilie Bolojan drept „o sectă” care, în pofida dificultăţilor financiare şi economice ale României, „aduce ode conducătorului iubit care a dus România în cap din punct de vedere economic”. El se arată „revoltat” de susţinerea pe care opozanţii PSD i-o acordă lui Ilie Bolojan, spunând că raţiunea de a fi împotriva PSD este singura care determină acţiunile acestora.

lithuania.title: „Rușii testează”. Moscova a trimis a treia zi la rând avioane de vânătoare în largul coastei Mării Baltice. Aparatele, interceptate
lithuania.description: Avioanele de vânătoare poloneze au interceptat încă două avioane de vânătoare rusești și un avion de recunoaștere în largul coastei Mării Baltice, a declarat joi ministrul polonez al apărării.

lithuania.title: Oana Țoiu: România va găzdui în premieră un program de schimb cu SUA. Ministra de Externe a prezentat bilanțul vizitei în Statele Unite
lithuania.description: Ministra Afacerilor Externe, Oana Țoiu, a prezentat, joi, bilanțul vizitei efectuate în Statele Unite, unde a avut întâlniri cu oficiali americani, reprezentanți ai mediului academic și ai unor think tank-uri. Șefa diplomației române a anunțat că, din această toamnă, România va găzdui în premieră Romania–United States Exchange Program, un program de schimb destinat consilierilor din Congresul SUA și experților americani.

lithuania.title: EXCLUSIV | Istoricul Cosmin Popa: Nu este realist să așteptăm o cerere de armistițiu de la Rusia, dimpotrivă, se radicalizează / Toamna va fi a intensificării războiului și a extinderii fronturilor / Ce ar putea să oprească succesele militare ale Kievului
lithuania.description: Ce se întâmplă cu Rusia? La finalul lunii iunie, președintele ucrainean Volodimir Zelenski promitea ”40 de zile de foc” pentru Rusia, în preajma Summitului NATO din Ankara, unde una dintre temele principale de discuție a fost războiul declanșat de dictatorul Vladimir Putin în 24 februarie 2022 și apărarea Ucrainei. La nici trei săptămâni de la […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: Rinkēvičs: Latvia and Lithuanuia share 'a bond based on bloodline'
lithuania.description: Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs continues his two-day visit to Lithuania on July 16th, as previously reported.

lithuania.title: Baltics and Poland warn again about potential Russian provocations
lithuania.description: Lithuania has intelligence information indicating that Russia may be preparing to carry out provocations of some sort in the Baltic region, Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda said in an interview with the BNS news agency.

lithuania.title: LRT: Lithuania considering reintroducing checks on Latvian border
lithuania.description: Lithuania's incoming Interior Minister Martynas Katelynas has not ruled out temporarily reintroducing border controls with Latvia as the number of migrants arriving from Belarus via Latvia continues to increase. Compared with the first half of last year, secondary migration from Latvia has risen fourfold, reports Lithuanian public media LRT.

lithuania.title: President Rinkēvičs heads to Lithuania
lithuania.description: Just a couple of weeks after heading north to visit Estonia, on July 15th President Edgars Rinkēvičs is heading south to visit Latvia's southern neighbour and fellow Baltic state, Lithuania.

lithuania.title: Lietuvā vairākas iestādes saņēmušas draudu vēstules – tajās ziņots par ēkās ievietotām sprāgstvielām
lithuania.description: Lietuvas augsto tehnoloģiju grupas “Teltonika” birojos Viļņā un Kauņā, kā arī vēl vienā biroju ēkā un neatliekamās medicīniskās palīdzības nodaļā Kauņā piektdienas priekšpusdienā saņemti viltus spridzināšanas draudi. Policija informēja, ka plkst. 11.40 saņemta informācija par “Teltonika” nosūtītu elektroniskā pasta vēstuli, kurā apgalvots, ka divās kompānijai piederošās ēkās Viļņā un Kauņā ir ievietotas sprāgstvielas, informēja Kauņas […]

lithuania.title: “Iespējams ir jebkas!” Kulbergs sniedzis interviju slavenam ārzemju medijam par Krievijas plānotajām provokācijām
lithuania.description: Latvija uzlabo energoobjektu aizsardzību bažās par iespējamām Krievijas provokācijām, intervijā aģentūrai “Reuters” atklāja Latvijas premjerministrs Andris Kulbergs. Latvijas, Lietuvas un Polijas līderi pēdējā laikā ir norādījuši uz Rietumvalstu izlūkdienestu brīdinājumiem, ka Krievija plāno provokācijas un uzbrukumus infrastruktūras objektiem reģionā. Kremlis gan tādus apgalvojumus dēvē par “šausmu stāstiem”. Uz “Reuters” jautājumu, vai saistībā ar tādiem risikiem […]

lithuania.title: “Krievija virzās ļoti lēni, Ukraina sit dziļumā!” NATO ģenerālsekretārs Rute vērtē situāciju frontē
lithuania.description: NATO ģenerālsekretārs Marks Rute paziņojis, ka Ukrainas aizsardzības ministra maiņa nemainīs valsts militāro stratēģiju karā pret Krieviju. Viņš uzsvēris, ka Ukrainas bruņotie spēki šobrīd darbojas ievērojami efektīvāk nekā gada sākumā, bet jaunais aizsardzības resora vadītājs turpinās jau izvēlēto kursu, vēsta dpa. Rute norādīja, ka Krievijas karaspēks turpina uzbrukumus, taču tā virzība frontē ir ļoti lēna. […]

lithuania.title: Četri Latvijas valstspiederīgie apsūdzēti spiegošanā Krievijas labā: vāca ziņas par NBS, robežu un Ukrainas atbalstītājiem, paši pat brauca uz Krieviju
lithuania.description: Prokuratūra nodevusi Rīgas pilsētas tiesai četras krimināllietas pret četrām personām, kuras apsūdzētas par nelikumīgu ziņu vākšanu un nodošanu ārvalsts izlūkdienestam ar prokremliskās noziedzīgās organizācijas “Baltijas antifašisti” vadītāja Sergeja Vasiļjeva starpniecību. Vienā no krimināllietām starp prokuroru un apsūdzēto noslēgta vienošanās par vainas atzīšanu un sodu, paredzot brīvības atņemšanu uz pieciem gadiem, savukārt pārējās trīs krimināllietas nodotas […]

lithuania.title: Pakrojas muižā ir sācies iespaidīgākais ziedēšanas laiks
lithuania.description: Ziemeļeiropas lielākajā ziedu festivālā ir sācies pats krāšņākais ziedēšanas periods. Pakrojas muižā iestājās iespaidīgākais laiks – brīdis, kad parks atklāj visu savu skaistumu. Tieši tagad miljoniem ziedu sasniedz ziedēšanas kulmināciju, pārvēršot Lietuvas lielāko muižas kompleksu dzīvā gleznā, kas piepildīta ar smaržām, košām krāsām un romantisku noskaņu. Katru dienu līdz pat vasaras beigām apmeklētājus priecēs vairāk […]

lithuania.title: Krievija sāk atriebties vēl vienai valstij par gatavību iesaistīties Ukrainas drošības garantijās
lithuania.description: Maskava, šķiet, sāk tirdzniecības karu ar Turciju laikā, kad Ankara paudusi gatavību piedalīties nākotnes drošības garantijās Ukrainai. Krievija sākusi ierobežot pārtikas produktu importu no Turcijas pēc tam, kad Turcijas puse paziņojusi par nodomu pievienoties nākotnes drošības garantijām Ukrainai. Ceturtdien, 16. jūlijā, Krievijas fitosanitārais uzraugs “Rosseļhoznadzor” paziņoja par ierobežojumu ieviešanu kauleņu augļu piegādēm no pieciem Turcijas […]

lithuania.title: Ukraina: Maskva ruošiasi rudenį mobilizuoti pusę milijono rusų
lithuania.description: Ukrainos Kovos su dezinformacija centro vadovas Andrijus Kovalenka pareiškė, kad Rusija rudenį planuoja mobilizuoti daugiau nei 500 tūkst. žmonių, taip siekdama papildyti nuostolius ir galimai atidaryti naują fronto kryptį.

lithuania.title: „Tai beprotybė“: Sakartvelas sukišo 25 mln. eurų, o dabar pastatą sulygins su žeme
lithuania.description: Sakartvelo sostinės Tbilisio pareigūnai pritarė nebaigto futuristinio kultūros komplekso nugriovimui, taip vėl pakurstydami diskusijas dėl vieno labiausiai miestą skaldančių objektų.

lithuania.title: „Laikas atidengti ugnį“: Kadyrovas paragino Putiną užpulti NATO
lithuania.description: Čečėnijos vadovas Ramzanas Kadyrovas platformoje „Telegram“ publikuotoje žinutėje atvėrė propagandos kloaką ir paragino Rusiją išplėsti karą ir surengti smūgius prieš NATO šalis, kurios remia Ukrainą ginklais, žvalgybos duomenimis ir kitokia pagalba.

lithuania.title: JAV ir Irano karas: kas vyksta Artimuosiuose Rytuose
lithuania.description: Šeštadienį karo veiksmai Artimuosiuose Rytuose suintensyvėjo po septintos iš eilės JAV atakų prieš Iraną nakties, Teheranui savo ruožtu grasinant „visapusišku puolimu“, o strateginiam Hormuzo sąsiauriui išliekant praktiškai uždarytam.

lithuania.title: Naujausia sinoptikų prognozė: visai Lietuvai – geltonasis perspėjimas dėl pavojingų orų
lithuania.description: Artimiausiomis dienomis sinoptikai prognozuoja smarkias liūtis, perkūnijas bei pavojingus vėjo gūsius.

lithuania.title: Maskvoje lankosi Šiaurės Korėjos užsienio reikalų ministrė
lithuania.description: Šiaurės Korėjos, remiančios Rusijos karą prieš Ukrainą, užsienio reikalų ministrė šeštadienį turi atvykti į Maskvą deryboms su Rusijos užsienio reikalų ministru Sergejumi Lavrovu, pranešė pastarojo biuras.

lithuania.title: Nuo rugsėjo Druskininkų moksleivių laukia dideli pokyčiai: įsigalios griežtas draudimas
lithuania.description: Nuo rugsėjo Druskininkų savivaldybės bendrojo ugdymo įstaigose įsigalios vienoda tvarka – moksleiviai, atvykę į mokyklą, telefonus turės laikyti užrakinamuose krepšeliuose ir negalės jais naudotis ugdymo proceso metu.

lithuania.title: Netoli Oslo – tragiškas gaisras: pleškina vieną eilę namų po kitos
lithuania.description: Norvegijos pietuose penktadienį kilęs didelis gaisras sunaikino daugiau nei 100 namų, o šimtai žmonių buvo priversti evakuotis iš šios vietovės, pranešė policija ir šalies visuomeninis transliuotojas.

lithuania.title: „Mes vieni kitus čia išžudysime“: Rusijoje apokalipsė – iš eilės prie degalinės į komisariatą“
lithuania.description: Rusijos Novosibirsko mieste policija į komisariatą išvežė mažiausiai 8 asmenis, kurie sukėlė konfliktą dėl to, kad automobilis, kurį liudininkai sieja su miesto administracija, degalinėje buvo aptarnautas be eilės, skelbia naujienų portalo „Laisvės radijas“ platforma „Sibir.Realii“.

lithuania.title: Naktis su Palangos policija: kovos dėl vaistų ir prievartaujamas vaikas
lithuania.description: Naktį iš penktadienio į šeštadienį Palangos policijos pareigūnams darbo netrūko. Kartu su naktinę pamainą dirbusiu ekipažu vyko ir 15min žurnalistė. Budėjimas prasidėjo nuo pareigūnams gerai pažįstamų vietos gyventojų konflikto, o baigėsi skubiu lėkimu per kurortą su įjungtais švyturėliais – iš automobilyje buvusio vaiko buvo gauti pavojaus signalai, leidę įtarti seksualinę prievartą.

lithuania.title: Pirmą kartą ant irklentės? Čempionė atskleidė tris svarbiausius patarimus
lithuania.description: Daugeliui irklentė vis dar asocijuojasi su lėtu pasiplaukiojimu ramiame ežere. Tačiau instruktorė, Lietuvos irklenčių čempionė, komunikacijos ekspertė ir dviejų vaikų mama Evelina Žičkienė sako, kad toks įsivaizdavimas – vienas didžiausių mitų.
